title: Za'atar and Feta Caesar Salad with Crunchy Crumbs
changes_from_base: Labneh-style yoghurt and feta replace the mayonnaise and Parmesan in the dressing, and za'atar breadcrumbs replace the croutons.
summary: A Caesar with an eastern Mediterranean accent: crisp romaine in a tangy yoghurt, feta and anchovy dressing, showered with lemony za'atar breadcrumbs and grated feta.
equipment: blender or stick blender with beaker

ingredients.note: a mix of dried thyme, sesame and sumac

ingredients.item: romaine hearts (about 3), leaves separated, large ones torn

steps.title: Toast the crumbs
steps.text: Melt the butter in the pan over medium-low heat, add the garlic for 30 sec, then the breadcrumbs. Stir for 3-5 min until golden. Off the heat, mix in the za'atar and lemon zest and leave to cool.

steps.title: Blend the dressing
steps.text: Blend the yoghurt, crumbled feta, lemon juice, anchovies, mustard, garlic and pepper until smooth, then blend in the oil in a thin stream until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Dress the leaves
steps.text: Make sure the lettuce is completely dry, then toss it in the bowl with the dressing until every leaf is coated.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Toss in half the grated feta and half the crumbs, then scatter the rest over the top. Serve straight away.

tips: Dry the leaves thoroughly or the thick dressing will slide off.
The crumbs keep in a jar for 3 days; make a double batch for soups and roast veg.
Grate the feta while it is cold and blotted dry so it falls in fine flakes.
storage: Dress just before serving. Keep the dressing (3 days) and crumbs (3 days, airtight) separately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
